name: Wentworth Falls & National Pass
blurb: Stairs cut into cliffs beside a tall waterfall. A proper adventure.
weatherNote: Steep stairs and cliff edges get dangerous when wet. Start early in summer.
gettingThere: Train from Central to Wentworth Falls station, then walk to the Falls Reserve picnic area.
newcomerTip: One of the most spectacular walks in the mountains, with stairs cut into the cliffs. Check NSW National Parks for track closures first.

legs.title: Blue Mountains Line to Wentworth Falls
Down Falls Rd to the picnic area
legs.detail: Or bus 685 to Fletcher St at Falls Rd, then ≈ 20 min on foot

back.text: From the Conservation Hut, walk up Fletcher St to Wentworth Falls station (≈ 30 min). Trains are roughly hourly: check the last one before you start the loop.

notes: Our tip: the picnic area car park fills by mid-morning on weekends.
Driving lets you add Leura or Katoomba on the same day.

routes.ride: Not practical: it's a long, expensive ride. The train is the easy option.

visit.bestTime: Start by 10am. The falls are best after rain, but the stairs are not: wait for a dry day.
visit.hours: The National Pass loop is closed until at least 31 March 2027 (NSW National Parks alert). Tracks also close after rockfalls or heavy rain: check the alerts before you go.
facilities: Toilets at the picnic area and Conservation Hut
Café at the Conservation Hut, 8am to 3pm daily
visit.access: Hundreds of steep steps and narrow ledges. Not suitable for prams, wheelchairs or anyone uneasy with heights.
safety: Stay on the track and behind railings
Tell someone your plan: phone signal drops in the valley
